KPI_1.name: M1 Opportunities Created Count for Non-Closed Won Opportunities with ACV > 0 for New and Existing Customers
KPI_1.description: Tracks the count of M1 stage opportunities created for active deals with positive ACV for both new and existing customer expansions.

KPI_2.name: M1 Starting ACV for Non-Closed Won Opportunities for New and Existing Customers
KPI_2.description: Measures the total starting Annual Contract Value for M1 stage opportunities excluding closed won deals for both customer segments.

KPI_3.name: S0 Opportunities Created Count for Non-Closed Won Opportunities with ACV > 0 for New and Existing Customers
KPI_3.description: Tracks the count of S0 stage opportunities created for active deals with positive ACV for both new and existing customer expansions.

KPI_4.name: S0 Starting ACV for Non-Closed Won Opportunities for New and Existing Customers
KPI_4.description: Measures the total starting Annual Contract Value for S0 stage opportunities excluding closed won deals for both customer segments.

KPI_5.name: S1 Opportunities Created Count for Non-Closed Won Opportunities with ACV > 0 for New and Existing Customers
KPI_5.description: Tracks the count of S1 stage opportunities created for active deals with positive ACV for both new and existing customer expansions.

KPI_6.name: S1 Starting ACV for Non-Closed Won Opportunities for New and Existing Customers
KPI_6.description: Measures the total starting Annual Contract Value for S1 stage opportunities excluding closed won deals for both customer segments.

KPI_7.name: S1 Opportunities Created Count for Non-Closed Won with Non-Null Creator Team
KPI_7.description: Tracks S1 stage opportunity creation count for deals with assigned creator teams, excluding closed won opportunities.

KPI_8.name: S0 Opportunities Created Count for Non-Closed Won with Non-Null Creator Team
KPI_8.description: Tracks S0 stage opportunity creation count for deals with assigned creator teams, excluding closed won opportunities.

KPI_9.name: M1 Opportunities Created Count for Non-Closed Won with Non-Null Creator Team
KPI_9.description: Tracks M1 stage opportunity creation count for deals with assigned creator teams, excluding closed won opportunities.

KPI_10.name: Total Opportunity ACV for Non-Closed Won Opportunities with ACV > 0 for New and Existing Customers
KPI_10.description: Measures the total Annual Contract Value for active opportunities with positive ACV for both new and existing customer segments.

attributes: Opportunity Type, Opportunity Stage, Opportunity Creator Profile, Opportunity Source Detailed, Opportunity Owner Name
goal: Track sales pipeline generation and progression by monitoring opportunity creation volumes and ACV values across different sales stages (M1, S0, S1) to optimize go-to-market performance and team productivity.
user_context: Sales managers and revenue operations teams use this dashboard during weekly and monthly business reviews to track early-stage opportunity creation across different funnel stages (M1, S0, S1), analyzing performance by individual contributors, teams, and opportunity sources to identify pipeline generation trends, assess team productivity, compare current week performance against historical periods, and make data-driven decisions about resource allocation and coaching needs while focusing on both new customer acquisition and existing customer expansion opportunities.
